verdict.rationale: vLLM documents efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers, allowing multiple LoRA adapters to be served/switched dynamically on a running server, which partially addresses 'multiple models' without restart. However, there is no evidence of hot-swapping arbitrary full base models on a single running server instance without restart. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI for loading a completely different base model at runtime, evidence of dynamic model add/remove endpoints, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
